<!-- openclaw-merge:6debef22-3ef8-44b2-9570-d2b6e6881dee -->

Additional release data point: in an isolated upgrade reproduction from 2026.10.6 to 2026.10.10-beta.3, a legacy isolated automation failed before inference with `Automation has no recorded inference account. Explicitly select its account with a model@profile update before running it.` An explicit account-selection update restored execution; the earlier release did not reproduce the failure.

beta.3's Doctor cron source lacks `inference-binding-migration.ts`, while main contains this repair. Its payload docs still require explicit legacy adoption. This appears consistent with a repair not yet included in that release branch. We did not test a build containing the migration, and this is not evidence that the merged repair fails. No account identifiers or job payloads are attached.
